sources.role: Family dimensions and exterior overview; official HST-3210 specification is not claimed as a measured HST-3200 dimension
Firsthand HST-3200 exterior and teardown, especially photo 041 rear T-shaped inlet and mini-DIN-10 key
Anders Montonen working Sega Saturn USB cartridge, original KiCad manufacturing design
sources.unit: InternalUnit 0.000100 INCH, explicitly declared in board file

sources.role: Manufacturer VNBC7S compatible IEC C7 nominal interface: 8.6 mm contact centres, 16.0 mm width and 7.85 mm height; not Sega OEM part identity
Cable maker confirms nominal 9.5 mm mini-DIN male sleeve and off-standard Saturn female socket; key fit inferred from firsthand console detail

card_edge_measurement.method: Read pad names, centres and board-edge segments in KiCad legacy text, convert declared 0.0001 inch units to millimetres and report nominal dimensions within file quantization.

changes: Card reader changes from two continuous 66-contact rows at 1.65 mm to keyed 67-contact rows at 1.0 mm.
Reader opening narrows to the verified card-edge width and gains a locating key for the 6 mm notch; outer case bay is retained.
Rear power inlet plate gains the photographed T-shaped lower stem and lower-left fixing; shell cut tool follows.
C7/C8 paired contact centres change to 8.6 mm; cable nose follows nominal 16 x 7.85 mm profile and contact bores clear retained study pins.
AV socket and cable gain paired upper orientation keys and lower flat stops; cable sleeve nominal diameter becomes 9.5 mm.
Controller receptacle contacts follow the existing plug study pitch of 2.55 mm, closing the previous 2.7/2.55 mismatch.
Estimated internal overlap lip closes the formerly see-through case seam, retaining all controller/service/side-vent clearances.

estimated_dimensions.inlet_plate: T silhouette and fixing position fitted from original HST-3200 detail; not a factory measurement
estimated_dimensions.mini_DIN: Socket clearance, flat-stop depth, key dimensions, axial depth and existing 3/4/3 contact centres remain approximate
estimated_dimensions.controller_pitch_basis: Existing study cable pitch, not verified OEM pitch
estimated_dimensions.case_overlap_lip: Estimated 1.2 mm internal wall with 0.3 mm nominal side clearance; no OEM drawing

remaining_limitations: Body curves, side/front details and graphics remain photographic estimates.
Primary working PCB establishes mating card geometry, not the original connector supplier or spring form.
The off-standard mini-DIN contact positions and local key clearances require physical metrology for a factory-equivalent model.
Controller interface pitch and C8 pin diameter remain explicit study dimensions; this model is not manufacturing or electrical documentation.
